031import java.lang.reflect.Modifier;

047/**
048 *  <p>T{@summary he implementation of
049 *  {@link TypeNameImpl}
050 *  for parameterised types.}</p>
051 *
052 *  @modified Thomas Thrien - thomas.thrien@tquadrat.org
053 *  @version $Id: ParameterizedTypeNameImpl.java 1151 2025-10-01 21:32:15Z tquadrat $
054 *  @since 0.0.5
055 *
056 *  @UMLGraph.link
057 */
058@ClassVersion( sourceVersion = "$Id: ParameterizedTypeNameImpl.java 1151 2025-10-01 21:32:15Z tquadrat $" )
059@API( status = INTERNAL, since = "0.0.5" )
060public final class ParameterizedTypeNameImpl extends TypeNameImpl implements ParameterizedTypeName
061{
062        /*------------*\
063    ====** Attributes **=======================================================
064        \*------------*/
065    /**
066     *  The enclosing type, if any.
067     */
068    @SuppressWarnings( "OptionalUsedAsFieldOrParameterType" )
069    private final Optional<ParameterizedTypeNameImpl> m_EnclosingType;
070
071    /**
072     *  The class name for this type.
073     */
074    @SuppressWarnings( "UseOfConcreteClass" )
075    private final ClassNameImpl m_RawType;
076
077    /**
078     *  The type arguments.
079     */
080    private final List<TypeNameImpl> m_TypeArguments;
081
082        /*--------------*\
083    ====** Constructors **=====================================================
084        \*--------------*/
085    /**
086     *  Creates a new {@code ParameterizedTypeNameImpl} instance.
087     *
088     *  @param  enclosingType   The optional enclosing type for this instance.
089     *  @param  rawType The class name for this instance.
090     *  @param  typeArguments   The type arguments.
091     */
092    @SuppressWarnings( "UseOfConcreteClass" )
093    public ParameterizedTypeNameImpl( final ParameterizedTypeNameImpl enclosingType, final ClassNameImpl rawType, final List<? extends TypeNameImpl> typeArguments )
094    {
095        this( enclosingType, rawType, typeArguments, new ArrayList<>() );
096    }   //  ParameterizedTypeNameImpl()
097
098    /**
099     *  Creates a new {@code ParameterizedTypeNameImpl} instance.
100     *
101     *  @param  enclosingType   The optional enclosing type for this instance.
102     *  @param  rawType The class name for this instance.
103     *  @param  typeArguments   The type arguments.
104     *  @param  ignored The annotations.
105     */
106    @SuppressWarnings( "UseOfConcreteClass" )
107    private ParameterizedTypeNameImpl( final ParameterizedTypeNameImpl enclosingType, final ClassNameImpl rawType, final List<? extends TypeNameImpl> typeArguments, final List<AnnotationSpecImpl> ignored )
108    {
109        this( Optional.ofNullable( enclosingType ), rawType, typeArguments, new ArrayList<>() );
110    }   //  ParameterizedTypeNameImpl()
111
112    /**
113     *  <p>{@summary {@constructor}}</p>
114     *
115     *  @param  enclosingType   The optional enclosing type for this instance.
116     *  @param  rawType The class name for this instance.
117     *  @param  typeArguments   The type arguments.
118     *  @param  annotations The annotations.
119     */
120    @SuppressWarnings( {"OptionalUsedAsFieldOrParameterType", "UseOfConcreteClass"} )
121    private ParameterizedTypeNameImpl( final Optional<ParameterizedTypeNameImpl> enclosingType, final ClassNameImpl rawType, final List<? extends TypeNameImpl> typeArguments, final List<AnnotationSpecImpl> annotations )
122    {
123        super( annotations );
124        m_RawType = requireNonNullArgument( rawType, "rawType" ).annotated( annotations.stream().map( a -> (AnnotationSpec) a ).collect( toList() ) );
125        m_EnclosingType = enclosingType;
126        m_TypeArguments = List.copyOf( requireNonNullArgument( typeArguments, "typeArguments" ) );
127
128        checkState( !m_TypeArguments.isEmpty() || enclosingType.isPresent(), () -> new IllegalArgumentException( "no type arguments: %s".formatted( rawType ) ) );
129        for( final var typeArgument : m_TypeArguments )
130        {
131            checkState( !typeArgument.isPrimitive() && (typeArgument != VOID_PRIMITIVE), () -> new IllegalArgumentException( "invalid type parameter: %s".formatted( typeArgument ) ) );
132        }
133    }   //  ParameterizedTypeNameImpl()
134
135        /*---------*\
136    ====** Methods **==========================================================
137        \*---------*/
138    /**
139     *  {@inheritDoc}
140     */
141    @Override
142    public final ParameterizedTypeNameImpl annotated( final List<AnnotationSpec> annotations )
143    {
144        final var retValue = new ParameterizedTypeNameImpl( m_EnclosingType, m_RawType, m_TypeArguments, concatAnnotations( annotations ) );
145
146        //---* Done *----------------------------------------------------------
147        return retValue;
148    }   //  annotated()
149
150    /**
151     *  {@inheritDoc}
152     */
153    @SuppressWarnings( {"PublicMethodNotExposedInInterface", "UseOfConcreteClass"} )
154    @Override
155    public final CodeWriter emit( final CodeWriter out ) throws UncheckedIOException
156    {
157        final var retValue = requireNonNullArgument( out, "out" );
158        if( m_EnclosingType.isPresent() )
159        {
160            m_EnclosingType.get().emit( retValue );
161            retValue.emit( "." );
162            if( isAnnotated() )
163            {
164                retValue.emit( " " );
165                emitAnnotations( retValue );
166            }
167            retValue.emit( m_RawType.simpleName() );
168        }
169        else
170        {
171            m_RawType.emit( retValue );
172        }
173
174        if( !m_TypeArguments.isEmpty() )
175        {
176            retValue.emitAndIndent( "<" );
177            var firstParameter = true;
178            for( final var parameter : m_TypeArguments )
179            {
180                if( !firstParameter ) retValue.emitAndIndent( ", " );
181                parameter.emit( retValue );
182                firstParameter = false;
183            }
184            retValue.emitAndIndent( ">" );
185        }
186
187        //---* Done *----------------------------------------------------------
188        return retValue;
189    }   //  emit()
190
191    /**
192     *  Returns a parameterised type, applying the given type arguments to the
193     *  given raw type.
194     *
195     *  @param  rawType The class name for the new type.
196     *  @param  typeArguments   The type arguments.
197     *  @return The new instance of {@code ParameterizedTypeName}.
198     */
199    @API( status = STABLE, since = "0.2.0" )
200    public static final ParameterizedTypeNameImpl from( final Class<?> rawType, final Type... typeArguments )
201    {
202        final var retValue = new ParameterizedTypeNameImpl( null, (ClassNameImpl) ClassName.from( rawType ), list( typeArguments ) );
203
204        //---* Done *----------------------------------------------------------
205        return retValue;
206    }   //  from()
207
208    /**
209     *  Returns a parameterised type, applying the given type arguments to the
210     *  given raw type.
211     *
212     *  @param  rawType The class name for the new type.
213     *  @param  typeArguments   The type arguments.
214     *  @return The new instance of {@code ParameterizedTypeName}.
215     */
216    @API( status = STABLE, since = "0.2.0" )
217    public static final ParameterizedTypeNameImpl from( final ClassName rawType, final TypeName... typeArguments )
218    {
219        final var retValue = new ParameterizedTypeNameImpl( null, (ClassNameImpl) rawType, stream( requireNonNullArgument( typeArguments, "typeArguments" ) ).map( t -> (TypeNameImpl) t ).collect( toList() ) );
220
221        //---* Done *----------------------------------------------------------
222        return retValue;
223    }   //  from()
224
225    /**
226     *  Returns a parameterised type equivalent to the given type, with the
227     *  given type arguments added.
228     *
229     *  @param  type    The other type.
230     *  @param  typeArguments   The type arguments.
231     *  @return The new instance of {@code ParameterizedTypeName}.
232     */
233    @API( status = STABLE, since = "0.2.0" )
234    public static final ParameterizedTypeNameImpl from( final ParameterizedType type, final Map<Type,TypeVariableName> typeArguments )
235    {
236        final var rawType = (ClassNameImpl) ClassName.from( (Class<?>) type.getRawType() );
237        final var ownerType = (type.getOwnerType() instanceof ParameterizedType) && !Modifier.isStatic( ((Class<?>) type.getRawType()).getModifiers() ) ? (ParameterizedType) type.getOwnerType() : null;
238        final var typeArgumentList = list( type.getActualTypeArguments(), typeArguments );
239        final var retValue = nonNull( ownerType )
240            ? from( ownerType, typeArguments ).nestedClass( rawType.simpleName(), typeArgumentList.stream().map( t -> (TypeName) t ).collect( toList() ) )
241            : new ParameterizedTypeNameImpl( null, rawType, typeArgumentList );
242
243        //---* Done *----------------------------------------------------------
244        return retValue;
245    }   //  from()
246
247    /**
248     *  {@inheritDoc}
249     */
250    @Override
251    public final ParameterizedTypeNameImpl nestedClass( final CharSequence name )
252    {
253        final var retValue = new ParameterizedTypeNameImpl( this, m_RawType.nestedClass( requireNonNullArgument( name, "name" ) ), new ArrayList<>(), new ArrayList<>() );
254
255        //---* Done *----------------------------------------------------------
256        return retValue;
257    }   //  nestedClass()
258
259    /**
260     *  {@inheritDoc}
261     */
262    @Override
263    public final ParameterizedTypeNameImpl nestedClass( final CharSequence name, final List<TypeName> typeArguments )
264    {
265        final var retValue = new ParameterizedTypeNameImpl( this, m_RawType.nestedClass( requireNonNullArgument( name, "name" ) ), typeArguments.stream().map( t -> (TypeNameImpl) t ).collect( toList() ), new ArrayList<>() );
266
267        //---* Done *----------------------------------------------------------
268        return retValue;
269    }   //  nestedClass()
270
271    /**
272     *  {@inheritDoc}
273     */
274    @Override
275    public final ClassNameImpl rawType() { return m_RawType; }
276
277    /**
278     *  {@inheritDoc}
279     */
280    @Override
281    public final List<TypeName> typeArguments()
282    {
283        final var retValue = m_TypeArguments.stream()
284            .map( typeArgument -> (TypeName) typeArgument )
285            .toList();
286
287        //---* Done *----------------------------------------------------------
288        return retValue;
289    }   //  typeArguments()
290
291    /**
292     *  {@inheritDoc}
293     */
294    @Override
295    public final ParameterizedTypeNameImpl withoutAnnotations()
296    {
297        final var retValue = new ParameterizedTypeNameImpl( m_EnclosingType, m_RawType.withoutAnnotations(), m_TypeArguments, new ArrayList<>() );
298
299        //---* Done *----------------------------------------------------------
300        return retValue;
301    }   //  withoutAnnotations()
302}
303//  class ParameterizedTypeNameImpl
